accessed.whyNeeded: The J-lens's core construction - averaging Jacobians over contexts to get a linear map that captures typical causal structure - follows the principle this work established for single relations; the paper presents its lens as the generalization of it.

The tuned lens is the trained per-layer alternative the J-lens is evaluated against throughout the lens-comparison sections, and the per-layer linear-correction idea the J-lens inherits is specified here.

The reward-hacking organism, its four checkpoints, and the characterization of its misalignment are all built there; section 5.4 only probes those artifacts, so their training pipeline matters for reading the results.
